title: photowright first real jobs: keep or redo

questions.title: Retouch: crash-site fin still
questions.question: Keep the retouched crash-site still, or redo it?
questions.background: Source: a frame at 95 s of D:/ComfyUI/output/video/final/crashsite/crashsite_120s_best_h_scored.mp4 (the tail fin at dusk), copied to D:/m4bwa/Claude/Projects/Ai/photowright-jobs/1-retouch/src/crashsite_fin_t95.png. phw ran three replayable steps: NL-means denoise (h 5), a curve that lifts the shadows (0.15 to 0.22) with saturation x1.12, then an unsharp mask in linear light. Result: D:/m4bwa/Claude/Projects/Ai/photowright-jobs/1-retouch/out/fin_retouched.png. Mean change per channel 0.04; replaying recipe.json gives the same picture within 5/255 (the step-by-step run saves 8-bit files between steps, the replay does not).
questions.why: A keep means retouch recipes like this one are good enough to offer for film stills; a redo tells me which way to push (stronger, softer, or a different fix).
look_for: The grass and the dark lower third: more detail without blotchy noise?
The sky gradient: any banding introduced?
The fin edge: sharper without a halo?

options.label: Keep the retouch as it is
Redo it stronger (more shadow lift and clarity)
Redo it softer (closer to the original grade)

guess.why: The change is gentle and clean; the frame was already well graded.

questions.title: Composite: Advanced Alloys card mock
questions.question: Keep the Advanced Alloys card mock (PNG, PSD and ORA), or redo it?
questions.background: Built from the SpaceDeckBuilder2 card art Assets/Images/Cards/advanced_alloys.png (96 px, scaled x2.5 nearest) and the card text in Assets/Docs/research_deck_v2.txt (New Subject, Silver). Eleven layers: frame, art window, art with a drop shadow, an overlay glow under a soft mask, title, rarity dot, type bar and rules text. Files: D:/m4bwa/Claude/Projects/Ai/photowright-jobs/2-composite/out/card.png, card.psd and card.ora (the recipe is card.json beside them). Both layered files flatten back to the PNG within 1/255. Text layers are pixels in the PSD and ORA, not editable text.
questions.why: A keep makes this the template for card mock-ups from the game's docs; a redo note on layout or type changes the template.
look_for: Does it read as a game card at a glance?
Title and rules text: size and font right?
Open card.psd in Photopea or GIMP if you want to check the layers.

media.alt: Card art source and the finished card mock

options.label: Keep the card mock and use it as the template
Redo the colours or fonts (see my note)

guess.why: Layout, text and layers all came out clean on the first pass.

questions.title: Batch: Arvum animal sprites x2
questions.question: Keep the x2 batch of the 12 Arvum animal sprite sheets, or redo it?
questions.background: Source copies of D:/Desktop/Create With Code Mark/ArvumElectrum/Assets/Art/Animals/Outline/*.png (12 sheets) in D:/m4bwa/Claude/Projects/Ai/photowright-jobs/3-batch/src/animals. Recipe normalise.json: resize x2 nearest, embed sRGB, strip metadata; dry run first, then applied to D:/m4bwa/Claude/Projects/Ai/photowright-jobs/3-batch/out/animals_x2. Checked: every visible pixel identical to its source, every 2x2 block uniform, colour counts unchanged; 26 fully transparent pixels in MiniBear and MiniFox lost their hidden RGB (invisible). This run found a bug: the first batch stretched every sheet to the Cow's size; fixed in the PR.
questions.why: A keep means x2 nearest is the right normalisation for Arvum sprite folders; a redo note names the size or format you want instead.
look_for: Edges stay hard, no blur or new colours?
Sheets keep their own sizes (Chicken is wider than Fox)?

media.alt: MiniFox and MiniChicken sheets before and after x2

options.label: Redo at another scale or size (see my note)
Not a useful normalisation for this folder

guess.why: It is pixel exact and proven by the checks.

questions.title: Trace: Electrum icon, pixel exact
questions.question: Keep the pixel-exact SVG of the 24 px Electrum icon, or redo it?
questions.background: Source: D:/Desktop/Create With Code Mark/ArvumElectrum/Assets/Art/Icons/Electrum.png (24x24), traced to D:/m4bwa/Claude/Projects/Ai/photowright-jobs/4-trace/out/electrum_pixel_v2.svg. Render-back overlap 1.000 (every pixel matches). It misses the pixel-art budgets (461 colours, 465 paths) because the icon is a downscaled painting, not palette pixel art. The first try scored 0.91 because soft-edge pixels were traced opaque; fixed (fill-opacity).
questions.why: A keep means exact squares are wanted even for painted icons; 'reduce colours first' means pixelwright should palette-lock icons before a trace.
look_for: Left and right should look identical at x10.
Is a 461-colour SVG useful to you, or should it be reduced to a small palette first?

media.alt: Electrum icon source and traced SVG at x10

options.label: Redo with the colours reduced to a small palette first
No use for a vector of this icon

guess.why: 461 colours in 24x24 is a heavy SVG; a 16-colour version would be lighter and still read the same.

questions.title: Trace: Arvum sun emblem for laser
questions.question: Keep the sun emblem DXF for laser engraving, or redo it?
questions.background: Source: D:/Desktop/Create With Code Mark/ArvumElectrum/Assets/Art/Icons/AppIcon.png (the gold and silver coin). A high-pass threshold made a black and white engrave mask (stains under 120 px dropped, rim circle added; script prep_emblem.py), traced with the own tracer: 570 nodes, overlap 0.988 against the mask, no open paths or crossings. Exported 100 mm wide as D:/m4bwa/Claude/Projects/Ai/photowright-jobs/4-trace/out/emblem_100mm_cut.dxf (closed polylines only, white background left out; Inkscape opens it) plus SVG and PDF. The mask, not the trace, is the weak part: some stains remain and the dotted ring is mostly lost.
questions.why: A keep means it is ready to try on the cutter; a redo means I clean the mask by hand rules (redraw rays and dot ring as geometry) before tracing.
look_for: The rays: clean enough to engrave?
The leftover blobs near the rim and bottom: acceptable or must go?
The dotted ring of the coin is missing: do you want it back?

media.alt: App icon, the engrave mask and the traced cut shapes

options.label: Keep it and try it on the laser
Redo with a cleaner mask (blobs gone, dot ring back)
Redo as drawn geometry instead of a trace

guess.why: The trace is faithful, but the stains would engrave as marks.

questions.title: Emblem: which tracer
questions.question: Which trace of the same emblem mask should the laser route use by default?
questions.background: Both traced D:/m4bwa/Claude/Projects/Ai/photowright-jobs/4-trace/out/emblem_bw.png. Left: VTracer (MIT), 1082 nodes, 35 paths, overlap 0.982. Right: the own region tracer at tolerance 1.0, 570 nodes, 2 paths, overlap 0.988. Fewer nodes cut faster and smoother.
questions.why: Sets the default backend for logo and emblem traces bound for a cutter.
look_for: Ray tips and the rim: which is smoother?
Small blobs: which keeps them cleaner?

guess.why: Half the nodes and a slightly higher overlap.
